entry.title: Meta4MPCXXL FX 0.1.2
entry.summary: **Meta4MPCXXL** (instrument) and **Meta4MPCXXL FX** (effect) play 4ms MetaModule patches — VCV Rack patches exported with the MetaModule hub — on the Akai Force (MPC OS 3.x, armv7), with 4ms's own open-source patch player and 215 built-in modules. - Every parameter on Q-Link pages of eight: knob sets first, then every module (names and values from the modules) - MIDI from the track and the Force's tempo/transport (MIDI clock) into the patch - MIDI To Hub Ins: pads/keys to the hub's Gate and CV i
